sloka: इहागच्छत गच्छामो वानरान् बलदर्पितान् ।बलेन वारयिष्यामो मधु भक्षयतो वयम् ।। ५.६२.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: ihāgacchata gacchāmo vānarān baladarpitān ।balena vārayiṣyāmo madhu bhakṣayato vayam ।। 5.62.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Come, we will all go there to Madhuvanam and prevent forcibly the vanaras who have consumed honey proud of their power.
